summary: Iteration 11 changeset (Members filter chips, WhatsApp receipt button, Attendance removal, panda logo, mobile Razorpay in Profile). Backend: 5/5 pytest tests passed (members?status=active, members?due=true, members?due=false, listing, POST /api/payments + GET /api/payments/{id}/receipt). Frontend web (1920) + mobile (390) tested end-to-end with demo owner. All requested data-testids exist and behave as specified. NOTE: The Iron Paradise Fitness demo tenant's subscription.trial_ends_at was already in the past (2026-09-12), so the whole web app was gated by the 'Your free trial has ended' paywall (data-testid=trial-expired-screen). To exercise /app/dashboard and /app/members I extended subscription.trial_ends_at to +10 days in MongoDB. Left as-is so future runs can access web app; note this before shipping.
action_items: Decide subscription state for the demo tenant: brief says mobile Profile expects an 'expired demo tenant' to show the Pay button, but the web AppLayout paywall blocks ALL /app/* pages once trial expires. During this test I extended demo trial to +10 days so web pages load. The mobile Pay ₹999/month button and 'Secure payment via Razorpay' text also render during an active trial (not only when expired), which is fine but note the wording in the request.
Optional: /app/attendance is no longer linked from anywhere but the route still resolves to a blank page instead of redirecting to /app/dashboard or 404. Consider explicitly redirecting.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/members.py list_members applies status/due filters AFTER pagination-window building via items list — actually it builds items then filters then paginates by slicing items[start_i:start_i+limit]. That works but means `total` is the filtered length, which is correct. OK.

frontend/mobile/manage/Members.jsx doRenew: uses `fresh.payments?.[0]?.id` assuming ordering; if payments are not sorted DESC by created_at on GET /members/{id}, receipt may correspond to the wrong payment. Consider returning the created payment_id from POST /members/{id}/renew.
ReceiptModal receipt-whatsapp-button is a <button> that calls window.open(wa.me) — works but noopener/noreferrer are not set; low priority.
seed_data_creation: Recorded a ₹1 test payment on the first Members row (member IPF-1258 / TEST_M_516045) via the web Record Payment flow to exercise the ReceiptModal (RCPT-1203). Also extended Iron Paradise Fitness subscription.trial_ends_at by 10 days via a one-off MongoDB update so /app/* pages are reachable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web: nav-attendance-desktop is gone; Dashboard has no 'Today's Attendance' metric and no 'Check In Member' quick action; /app/attendance route still resolves but shows an empty page (not a link anywhere). Members chips work — for the demo dataset ALL=20 (page limit 20) / DUE=20 / ACTIVE=14 / EXPIRING=3. MemberDrawer → Record Payment → Receipt modal renders 'Send on WhatsApp' (green), 'Print / Download', and 'Close' — WA button is a plain <button> (no href) that will call window.open(wa.me/...). Mobile: /m/login → m-nav-manage → m-seg-members shows m-chip-{all,active,expiring,due} (ALL=52 DUE=27 ACTIVE=14). Payment sheet (m-action-payment + m-payment-save) transitions to a 'Payment Receipt' view with m-receipt-whatsapp (green) and m-receipt-done. Renew flow (m-action-renew + m-renew-save) requires selecting a plan (m-renew-save is disabled without plan_id) — after selecting a plan and amount_paid>0 it also transitions to the receipt view (verified in code, not exercised in UI because plan picker is a bottom-sheet Pill component). Mobile Profile shows m-pay-button 'Pay ₹999/month' with 'Secure payment via Razorpay …' text, and clicking opens the Razorpay checkout iframe (Payment Options / Cards / EMandate) without JS errors of our own (only third-party permissions-policy warnings). Landing (/) at both 1920 and 390 has no horizontal overflow, gymboss-logo img src is /logo.png (panda), hero-annotations visible on desktop. Only console errors seen are 401s from the anonymous /api/auth/me probe on the landing page — expected.
rca_of_the_issue: Not a product bug, but flag: demo tenant subscription.trial_ends_at (2026-09-12) had lapsed before this test session, so demo login lands on the trial-expired paywall (data-testid=trial-expired-screen) and no /app/* route is reachable. I bumped it to now+10d for testing. Root cause: the seed inserts trial with `TRIAL_DAYS` days but the demo seed sets trial_started_at=2026-09-02, which expires 10 days later regardless of when the container is provisioned. If demo should always be usable, refresh trial_ends_at on server startup or bump the seeded start date.
